summary: Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of a share capital reduction and reorganization previously approved by shareholders. The par value of issued Class A and Class B ordinary shares was reduced from US$1.875 to US$0.00001, with the resulting credit transferred to a distributable reserve. Authorized unissued shares were subdivided, canceled, then increased to US$33,000 divided into 3 billion Class A and 300 million Class B ordinary shares. The Cayman Registrar approved the changes on April 30, 2026. This is a routine capital restructuring with no special-situation catalyst; no premium, deal terms, or strategic event.
